record.title: Oncupinar prohibition on direct passage of Turkish trucks, 2011–2019
record.exceptions: Transshipment of goods to Syrian trucks continued; direct vehicle entry permission reportedly effective 4 March, observed passage documented 5 March.
record.enforcement: Scope-limited evidence; uniform enforcement beyond the named crossings and movement categories is not inferred.
record.relationship: Left-censored vehicle restriction continuing within study window; not the Bab al-Hawa episode ME020 or R3-ME-002.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence in cited sources only; no present-status inference.
record.official_rationale: Restriction associated with the Syrian civil war; precise original order not retrieved.
record.context: Goods continued by transshipment to Syrian trucks, so this is a vehicle-category restriction, not an eight-year goods embargo.
record.uncertainty: Retrospective onset only to year; reopening is first reviewed operational evidence, one day after permission. Other passenger and freight regimes at this post are separate.

historical.duration_note: Not eligible for a single continuous-duration calculation; see movement scope, phases and uncertainty

All applicable broad categories are retained together; no primary rationale is imposed. Prior evidence assessment (before this recoding): Syrian civil war linked to direct-truck prohibition. Limits retained: Civil-war safety context; no general ban on all goods.
Turkish vehicles forced to transfer goods to Syrian trucks at Oncupinar; goods themselves not wholly barred.
Eight-year retrospective not a daily operational record; no exact interval.
